method: Python standard-library independent raw CIF/SDF parsers; source atom/number/bond maps; all-pairs source-to-SDF distance invariance and chiral handedness; residue graph restoration and raw CCD comparison; actual projection-model heavy graph and tetrahedral handedness versus raw CCD in normal/turned orientations; reducing/branch endpoints derived from actual SDF neighbors.
scope: Shipped configurations and fragment topology; not solution populations, energies or full biological architecture.
